description: The plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) performance during fine-tuning of the Whisper “tiny” model across six epochs, comparing five different quantization and adaptation strategies: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”, “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”, “tiny int4”, “tiny int8”, and “tiny full”. The x-axis represents the epoch number, ranging from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at each epoch. The y-axis shows WER values on a linear scale from approximately 25 to 70. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” line (solid dark green with circle markers) starts at ~69 WER at epoch 0 and steadily declines to ~40 by epoch 6. The “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” line (solid dark green with square markers) begins at ~60, drops to ~51 at epoch 1, then plateaus around 40–41 from epoch 3 onward. The “tiny int4” line (dashed dark green with circle markers) starts at ~69, falls to ~55 at epoch 1, then continues decreasing to ~37 by epoch 6. The “tiny int8” line (dashed dark green with square markers) begins at ~60, drops to ~47 at epoch 1, then declines more gradually to ~32 by epoch 6. The “tiny full” line (dotted dark green with triangle markers) starts at ~29, dips slightly to ~27 at epoch 1, then fluctuates between ~24 and ~26 through epoch 6, remaining consistently the lowest WER across all epochs. All lines show improvement over time, with “tiny full” maintaining the best performance throughout.
